heading: Purposes
lead: The purposes of this part are to—

tree.text: address violent crime by increasing the number of police with advanced education and training on community patrol; and
provide educational assistance to law enforcement personnel and to students who possess a sincere interest in public service in the form of law enforcement.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 14091 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: For short title of subtitle A of title XX of Pub. L. 103–322, which is classified to this part, as the “Police Corps Act”, see section 200101 of Pub. L. 103–322, set out as a Short Title of 1994 Act note under section 10101 of this title.
